name: resume-grill
description: Resume-based interview prep in four modes: grill a resume into technical interview questions with model answers and a printable scorecard, weakness analysis, resume optimization without invented facts, and job-description match; every result is linked HTML that exports to PDF. 简历拷打：面试拷打、弱点分析、简历优化、JD匹配四种模式，一句话启动，产物为可导出PDF的HTML。
